name: OpenAI
category_description: App node - connects to an external service API
description: Use the OpenAI node to automate work in OpenAI and integrate OpenAI with other applications. n8n has built-in support for a wide range of OpenAI features, including creating images and assistants, as well as chatting with models

parameters.name: Credential to connect with
parameters.description: Create or select an existing OpenAI credential

parameters.name: Resource
parameters.description: Select Text

parameters.name: Operation
parameters.description: Select Generate a Chat Completion

parameters.name: Model
parameters.description: Select the model you want to use. If you’re not sure which model to use, try gpt-4o if you need high intelligence or gpt-4o-mini if you need the fastest speed and lowest cost. Refer to Models overview | OpenAI Platform for more information

parameters.name: Messages
parameters.description: Enter a Text prompt and assign a Role that the model will use to generate responses. Refer to Prompt engineering | OpenAI for more information on how to write a better prompt by using these roles. Choose from one of these roles:

parameters.name: Simplify Output
parameters.description: Turn on to return a simplified version of the response instead of the raw data

parameters.name: Output Content as JSON
parameters.description: Turn on to attempt to return the response in JSON format. Compatible with GPT-4 Turbo and all GPT-3.5 Turbo models newer than gpt-3.5-turbo-1106

options.name: Frequency Penalty
options.description: Apply a penalty to reduce the model's tendency to repeat similar lines. The range is between 0.0 and 2.0

options.name: Maximum Number of Tokens
options.description: Set the maximum number of tokens for the response. One token is roughly four characters for standard English text. Use this to limit the length of the output

options.name: Number of Completions
options.description: Defaults to 1. Set the number of completions you want to generate for each prompt. Use carefully since setting a high number will quickly consume your tokens

options.name: Presence Penalty
options.description: Apply a penalty to influence the model to discuss new topics. The range is between 0.0 and 2.0

options.name: Output Randomness (Temperature)
options.description: Adjust the randomness of the response. The range is between 0.0 (deterministic) and 1.0 (maximum randomness). We recommend altering this or Output Randomness (Top P) but not both. Start with a medium temperature (around 0.7) and adjust based on the outputs you observe. If the responses are too repet

options.name: Output Randomness (Top P)
options.description: Adjust the Top P setting to control the diversity of the assistant's responses. For example, 0.5 means half of all likelihood-weighted options are considered. We recommend altering this or Output Randomness (Temperature) but not both. Defaults to 1.0

parameters.name: Resource
parameters.description: Select Text

parameters.name: Operation
parameters.description: Select Generate a Model Response

parameters.name: Model
parameters.description: Select the model you want to use. Refer to Models overview | OpenAI Platform for an overview

parameters.name: Messages
parameters.description: Choose from one of these a Message Types:

parameters.name: Simplify Output
parameters.description: Turn on to return a simplified version of the response instead of the raw data

options.name: Web Search
options.description: Allows models to search the web for the latest information before generating a response

options.name: MCP Servers
options.description: Allows models to connect to remote MCP servers. Find out more about using remote MCP servers as tools

options.name: File Search
options.description: Allow models to search your knowledgebase from previously uploaded files for relevant information before generating a response. Refer to the OpenAI documentation for more information

options.name: Code Interpreter
options.description: Allows models to write and run Python code in a sandboxed environment

options.name: Maximum Number of Tokens
options.description: Set the maximum number of tokens for the response. One token is roughly four characters for standard English text. Use this to limit the length of the output

options.name: Output Randomness (Temperature)
options.description: Adjust the randomness of the response. The range is between 0.0 (deterministic) and 1.0 (maximum randomness). We recommend altering this or Output Randomness (Top P) but not both. Start with a medium temperature (around 0.7) and adjust based on the outputs you observe. If the responses are too repet

options.name: Output Randomness (Top P)
options.description: Adjust the Top P setting to control the diversity of the assistant's responses. For example, 0.5 means half of all likelihood-weighted options are considered. We recommend altering this or Output Randomness (Temperature) but not both. Defaults to 1.0

options.name: Conversation ID
options.description: The conversation that this response belongs to. Input items and output items from this response are automatically added to this conversation after this response completes

options.name: Previous Response ID
options.description: The ID of the previous response to continue from. Can't be used in conjunction with Conversation ID

options.name: Reasoning
options.description: The level of reasoning effort the model should spend to generate the response. Includes the ability to return a Summary of the reasoning performed by the model (for example, for debugging purposes)

options.name: Store
options.description: Whether to store the generated model response for later retrieval via API. Defaults to true

options.name: Output Format
options.description: Whether to return the response as Text, in a specified JSON Schema or as a JSON Object

options.name: Background
options.description: Whether to run the model in background mode. This allows executing long-running tasks more reliably
